findingRules.dead: no core outcome resolved in any group at any step
findingRules.intendedMiss: the largest elasticity on an intended outcome is under 0.05, or nothing resolved on it
findingRules.sideEffect: an outcome the lever is not for moves with an elasticity of 0.5 or more (rate outcomes, all cells)
findingRules.byLevel: the high-step elasticity differs between two Levels by more than 0.3 and by more than a factor of two, or changes sign, both resolved
findingRules.byStyle: at one step the outcome rises for one lone way and falls for another, both resolved
findingRules.redundant: two levers whose effect vectors (every cell, every core rate outcome, lowest and highest step) have a cosine of 0.9 or more, or -0.9 or less
findingRules.nonlinear: the low-step and high-step elasticities differ by 0.25 or more and by 30% of the larger, both resolved
